sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface display confirmed: L2 describes the construct as 'full-length surface-displayed'; L4 (GFP-tagged companion construct) shows robust cell-surface expression by confocal microscopy in HEK293 cells. L5 uses anti-HA flow cytometry to measure total receptor synthesis. No agonist-stimulated signaling assay with the tagged receptor is reported in the ledger.
sites.rationale: ADRA2B is a GPCR with no signal peptide; its N-terminus (residues 1–12) is extracellular and is the only extracellular terminus. Multiple independent publications (L1, L2, L3, L5) report a full-length, membrane-anchored ADRA2B construct with 3xHA prepended at the N-terminus and confirm surface display. No residue number is stated in any ledger line, so the junction is topology-derived: insert_after_residue=0 places the tag before M1, 12 residues from TM1 (well above the ≥3 aa minimum). Python-verified: seq[0]='M'. Full-length ADRA2B bearing three tandem HA (YPYDVPDYA) tags at its N-terminus expressed in pcDNA3.1(-) in mammalian cells; construct described as 'full-length surface-displayed receptor' (L2). The same N-terminal 3xHA construct is cross-referenced in L1, L3, and L5. ADRA2B has no signal peptide (UniProt P18089); the N-terminus (residues 1–12) is directly extracellular, making this the sole extracellular terminus.

All other materials were obtained as described elsewhere 35 , 36 .
α 2B -AR tagged with three HA (YPYDVPDYA) at its N-terminus in the pcDNA3.1(-) vector was generated as described previously 8 .

literature_notes: Five ledger lines were evaluated. L1, L2, L3, and L5 all ground the N-terminal 3xHA site on the extracellular face; L2 is the primary citation as it most explicitly describes the construct as 'full-length surface-displayed.' L1, L3, and L4 also report a C-terminal GFP fusion, but the C-terminus (residues 430–450) is intracellular per the authoritative topology landmarks, so that tag is recorded in other_positions. No ledger line reports any insertion in ECL1 (76–85), ECL2 (150–170), or ECL3 (392–407) of ADRA2B, so no internal sites are proposed. The N-terminal tag position is topology_derived (not validated) because no ledger line names a specific residue number for the junction.

literature_other_positions.note: GFP fused at the C-terminus of full-length ADRA2B; the C-terminus (residues 430–450) is intracellular per topology landmarks, so this is not a surface tag site.
